The 20-F uses spaces as thousands separators (12 603 = 12,603). Only the USA is a single country; the other three areas are Novartis groupings with no country list, so countries is null for them. Switzerland is not broken out. Sites are the full 'Major facilities' table in Item 4.D (site size in square meters); Novartis says it runs 33 manufacturing sites in total. A web search found no published Novartis group country-by-country tax table (only a local Romania extract, not opened), so no tax rows; no state-level data.
